provider: Maven Central (Sonatype Central Portal) - post-2026 publishing limits

free_tier.stated: Maven Central introduced hard monthly *publishing* limits per organization in 2026. Three independent metrics: file count, release size, release count, evaluated as hard thresholds against the current calendar month, with a 30-day grace period on first breach (resets after 2 consecutive below-limit months). Thresholds are set near the top-10% of publishers; the published distribution table gives 90th percentile = 1,167 files / 78 MB release size / 7 releases per month, 99th = 17,724 / 1,808 MB / 50. Separately, from 2026-10-01, any artifact with a 'commercial nature' requires a paid Publisher Pro subscription regardless of volume.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Three independent metrics: file count, release size, release count, evaluated as hard thresholds against the current calendar month, with a 30-day grace period on first breach (resets after 2 consecutive below-limit months)

egress.terms: Free and effectively unmetered for consumers - repo1.maven.org is a heavyweight CDN. Publishing is what is metered, not download.

tooling: `mvn deploy` / central-publishing-maven-plugin, `gradle` publishing, `curl` to the Central Portal API, and plain HTTPS Maven-layout GETs from repo1.maven.org. No rclone backend.
chaining: unlimited namespaces/group-ids x unlimited organizations x (monthly release-size threshold, ~78 MB at p90, ~1.8 GB at p99). Because limits are per *organization per month* and reset monthly, an organization publishing 1.8 GB/month sustained is ~21.6 GB/year - three orders of magnitude short of 20 TiB. Multiplying by many free organizations multiplies the account surface, not the rate, and every org has the same monthly reset.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none stated for a single artifact, but release *size* is the metered metric. request-rate: publishing limits are monthly per-org (file count / release size / release count). retention: indefinite for already-published artifacts - 'Public artifacts already published to Maven Central remain available for download.' Enforcement blocks *new releases*, not existing storage. Commercial-nature artifacts require Publisher Pro from 2026-10-01.

reliability_note: The 2026 change is the important signal for the whole niche: the largest free package registry concluded that '10% of namespaces accounted for more than 88% of all files published' and moved to hard monthly thresholds plus a commercial-use gate. Any plan that treats a public registry as a bulk blob store is now rate-limited at ~GB/month/org, not capped at a total. Already partly covered in round 1 C-C2; the exact thresholds table and the commercial-nature gate are new.
